title: Live updates: Bitcoin bounces back to $82,000 after first fall below $80,000 in one month
summary: Stocks also turned positive after big early losses, helped by sharply lower bond yields.
content:
coverage endedOct 15, 2026, 5:00 p.m. EDT

Stocks also turned positive after big early losses, helped by sharply lower bond yields.

TeraWulf CEO updates after 'a brutal few days' for neoclouds

“A brutal few days across the AI infrastructure sector, and TeraWulf WULF$12.61·Market Closed has been no exception,” tweeted company CEO Paul Prager earlier this afternoon.

After speaking with a group of investors organized by Morgan Stanley yesterday, Prager summarized some of the issues and his responses.

Among them were the questions about the effect of high interest rates.

“Our customers are investing billions in compute to generate substantial economic returns,” said Prager. “The cost of delaying that capacity can far exceed the incremental cost of financing it today.”

“That's why financing costs are central to our lease negotiations and, where contractually provided, borne by the tenant … Higher rates matter. But so does the value of time. Our job is to protect the economics.”

And on execution:

“At Lake Mariner, we're advancing CB4 and CB5 toward their planned Q4 and Q1 deliveries. And our construction costs remain squarely within guidance. We're currently tracking ~$9 million per critical IT MW at Lake Mariner, within our $8–10 million guidance range.”

WULF is higher by 9.2% today, but still lower by 9% over the past five days.

Bonds continue rally, but Fed Chair Kevin Warsh speaks tonight

It was late August when then-newish Fed Chair Kevin Warsh surprised markets with his hawkish Jackson Hole speech, setting up a rate hike a few weeks later.

The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield was at about 4.65% when Warsh gave that speech and rose to 5.30% by early October.

The Fed chair speaks again tonight (11:30 pm ET), and yields have tumbled in the past two days despite two very troubling inflation reports.

It’s possible that Warsh goes with the flow and eases back on the hawkish rhetoric, given recent equity market stumbles. However, thanks in part to those two poor inflation reportss, it seems more likely Warsh will reiterate his hawkish position, setting markets up for multiple rate hikes in coming months.

“Warsh has no choice tonight, he has to sound even more hawkish than at Jackson Hole,” said one trader. “Fresh off hot CPI and PPI, anything soft will be read as surrender.”

Nvidia's Huang attempts to calm CoreWeave concerns

Nvidia NVDA$217.23·Market Closed doesn’t need to backstop CoreWeave (CRWV), said Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, speaking at an event in Sweden.

CoreWeave’s cost of capital is “actually decreasing,” he added, with strength improving every day.

Nvidia, of course, has a major stake in CoreWeave, having invested $2 billion into the neocloud’s common stock earlier this year. CoreWeave’s data centers run nearly totally on Nvidia chips and hardware.

CRWV has narrowed its loss on the day to 2.9%, but remains lower by nearly 50% over the past six months.

Crypto moves to gains alongside stock market

A recovery in U.S. stocks is spreading to crypto in late-morning U.S. hours.

Down nearly 1.5% earlier, the Nasdaq is just shy of flat on the session, while the S&P 500 climbs 0.2% and the DJIA rises more than 1%.

Bitcoin BTC$80,955.28 has risen about 3% in the past 90 minutes, now trading at $82,200, up 0.5% over the past 24 hours.

Solana (SOL) is leading among the majors, up 1.7%.

Supporting risk markets is a fast drop in bond yields, the 10-year U.S. Treasury now trading at 5.09% after reaching 5.36% at one point yesterday following the fast September CPI report.

Among crypto-related stocks, Circle Financial CRCL$86.99·Market Closed is leading with a 6.7% gain. Also higher are Strategy MSTR$151.24·Market Closed, up 2.4%, Coinbase COIN$183.75·Market Closed, up 2.4%, and Securitize (SECZ), up 3.9%.

Circle’s USDC becomes first stablecoin classified as ‘significant’ under EU’s MiCA

The European Banking Authority (EBA) classified Circle's USDC as the first “significant” e-money token under the EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation.

USDC is the first of the 45 e-money MiCA-registered tokens to receive the designation. The EBA will oversee USDC's capital requirements, reserves and liquidity, while France's banking regulator will retain responsibility for governance and other areas.

The EBA also signed an agreement with New York regulators to coordinate oversight of USDC's operations across Europe and the U.S.

Quick bounce in crypto after bitcoin slips below $80,000

Buyers have quickly stepped in, making bitcoin’s first dip below $80,000 in one month a very brief one.

The price has quickly rebounded to above $81,000, still lower by 1% over the past 24 hours. Solana is down similarly, with ether and XRP each lower by 2%.

The bounce in crypto comes alongside one for stocks, with the Nasdaq narrowing its big early decline to 0.8% and the S&P now down just 0.25%.

Selloff in neocloud and bitcoin mining stocks deepens

The selloff across neocloud and bitcoin mining stocks is deepening. Soluna (SLNH) is down 85% from its all-time high, followed by Boost Run (BRUN) at 77%, Cipher Digital CIFR$10.06·Market Closed at 67%, CleanSpark CLSK$9.3460·Market Closed at 60% and CoreWeave (CRWV) at 56%.

CoreWeave has become the focal point as concerns spread from equities into credit markets. Its unsecured bonds maturing in 2032 traded as high as 15% yield, according to Bloomberg. Investors are demanding a substantially higher return to hold the company’s debt, signalling growing concern about its creditworthiness.

Investor Chamath Palihapitiya highlighted the warning on Tuesday, sharing a chart showing neoclouds falling as CoreWeave’s bonds sold off. CoreWeave shares then plunged more than 15% on Wednesday, and 8% thursday, alongside a broader retreat in AI infrastructure stocks. The sequence suggests credit-market concerns preceded the latest equity selloff, although it does not establish that they caused it.

Bitcoin trading with $79K handle for first time in a month

With U.S. stocks adding to early losses, bitcoin has lost the $80,000 level for the first time since mid-September.

Trading at $79,950, it’s now lower by 3.5% over the past 24 hours.

The Nasdaq is down 1.4% and S&P 500 0.6%.

Government bond yields, meanwhile, are at session lows, the U.S. 10-year now down 15 basis points to 5.04%, its softest level in about one month.

Bitcoin battles at $80,000 level as Nasdaq slips 'just' 0.9% in early trading

Bitcoin BTC$80,955.28 is trading at $80,500 shortly after the open of U.S. stocks, down 2.9% over the past 24 hours. It’s traded down to just dollars above $80,000 in recent minutes, with buyers stepping in to prevent a $79K handle for the first time since mid-September.

For the moment, the worst fears of the tech sector haven’t come to fruition, the Nasdaq slipping just 0.9%.

Small gains for Microsoft, Apple, and Google are masking the destruction going on in the AI favorites. Micron, Intel and AMD are all lower by more than 4%. Dell, Arista Networks, and SanDisk are down by about 7%.

U.S. Treasury yields add to sharp declines after PPI report

The shockingly fast PPI report didn’t dent the rally in fixed income.

The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield is at a session low, down 14.5 basis points to 5.044%. The iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) is up 2% in pre-market trading, extending its rebound from recent lows to 5%.

The CME FedWatch tool now shows a 27% probability of a 25-basis-point rate hike at the Fed’s Oct. 28 meeting. At one point yesterday, the odds were nearly 45%.

U.S. PPI delivers more bad news on inflation

The September U.S. Producer Price Index rose a whopping 1.3%, far above August’s 0.4%, and blowing past forecasts for 0.5%.

On a year-over-year basis, PPI was higher by 6.3%, up from 5.4% in August, and above estimates for 5.3%.

The core PPI rose 0.7% versus 0.2% in August, and well above forecasts for 0.3%.

Year-over-year core PPI rose 5%, up from 4.6% in August, and higher than estimates for 4.4%.

Market reaction, for now, is rather muted:

Already under pressure on Thursday, bitcoin BTC$80,955.28 slumped about another $500 on the news to $80,500. Nasdaq 100 futures remain lower by 1% and bond yields remain sharply lower in response to growing concerns about the popping of the AI bubble.

In other economic news, initial jobless claims remained at historically low levels, edging up to 199,000 from 197,000.

Retail sales for September were stronger than forecast, rising 0.9% (ex-autos) versus the 0.5% estimate.

The October Empire State Manufacturing Index jumped to 25.5 from 7.6 in September, well above forecasts for a rise to 10.3.

South Korea's Kospi now down 20% in seven sessions

The chip-heavy (Samsung, SK Hynix) Kospi plunged another 7.5% overnight, as the U.S. slump Wednesday made its way around the globe.

According to Bespoke, the Kospi is now down 20% over the past seven trading days — the worst seven-day stretch since the Covid panic of March 2020.

The Kospi remains higher by 29% year-to-date.

Nasdaq 100 futures are lower by 1%, but have bounced a bit from their worst levels. S&P 500 futures are just marginally lower and DJIA futures are up 0.3%.

A fixed income rally is providing support. The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield is down another 10 basis points to 5.088%. At one point on Wednesday, following the fast CPI report, the 10-year yield spiked to 5.36%.

The September PPI report is coming up shortly.

Bitcoin is at $81,000, up a bit from its worst levels, but down 2.75% over the past 24 hours. Ether, solana, and XRP are lower by 4%-5%.

Ether bounces from two-month lows

Ether has recovered to $2,360, up from $2,314 hit early Thursday — its lowest level since Aug. 20, according to CoinDesk data.

ETH has pulled back sharply since topping $2,800 on Sept. 21, with the decline outpacing bitcoin’s.

A likely catalyst for the underperformance is elevated bond yields, which reduce the appeal of yield-generating DeFi protocols, a sector still largely built on Ethereum.

The AI selloff continues led by CoreWeave

The AI selloff continues led by CoreWeave (CRWV), which is down 4% in pre-market trading after tumbling more than 15% on Wednesday. Other AI infrastructure stocks are also under pressure, with Cipher Digital CIFR$10.06·Market Closed down 5%, TeraWulf WULF$12.61·Market Closed falling 6% and IREN IREN$30.40·Market Closed losing 4%.

Bitcoin has been dragged below $81,000, while gold appears to be the main beneficiary, rising more than 1% to reclaim $4,150 an ounce.

ZEC led crypto losses, down 11% to about $1,100. Ether dropped 5% to about $2,370, and U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $261 million on Wednesday, according to SoSoValue data.

title: Hyperliquid founder wants U.S. oversight of trading platforms, not his blockchain
summary: Jeff Yan told Bloomberg that U.S. regulatory oversight should apply to the firms using the blockchain, not to the underlying network itself.
content:
Summary

  • Hyperliquid founder Jeff Yan said U.S. regulators should oversee financial firms operating on the blockchain rather than regulate the network itself.
  • Yan’s proposal could allow Wall Street firms to build regulated trading businesses on Hyperliquid without requiring the blockchain to register as an exchange.
  • Kraken parent Payward plans to offer U.S. investors derivatives using Hyperliquid’s technology through a regulated exchange, even as Hyperliquid’s perpetual futures market remains closed to them.

Hyperliquid founder Jeff Yan wants U.S. regulators to oversee financial firms using his blockchain rather than the network itself.

Companies operating trading markets on Hyperliquid should be responsible for meeting regulatory requirements, much like financial firms using internet infrastructure, Yan said Thursday in a Bloomberg interview.

“The regulation sits at the layer where there are controls, and indeed the deployers are the ones that exercise these controls,” Yan said.

Hyperliquid, best known for its eponymous perpetual futures trading platform, remains closed to U.S. customers.

However, Kraken’s parent company, Payward, plans to offer investors in the country derivatives using Hyperliquid’s technology through a regulated exchange. For Hyperliquid, this means it could add a Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) regulated operator even though its perps market remains unavailable to U.S. customers.

Yan’s proposal would allow Wall Street firms to build trading businesses on Hyperliquid without requiring the blockchain itself to operate as a regulated exchange.

“We’re not trying to displace anything,” Yan said. “In fact, I think the technology can benefit everyone who currently operates markets in a more traditional setting.”

His comments come after President Donald Trump said in August that the CFTC was working to bring Hyperliquid into the U.S. under federal regulations.

title: VanEck Pulls Lido Staked Ethereum ETF After 1 Year, Ending stETH Fund Plan
summary:
Key Takeaways: VanEck has suggested to the Securities and Exchange Commission that it remove its proposed Lido Staked ETH registration. The S-1 was filed for the first time on October
The post VanEck Pulls Lido Staked Ethereum ETF After 1 Year, Ending stETH Fund Plan appeared first on CryptoNinjas.
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • VanEck has suggested to the Securities and Exchange Commission that it remove its proposed Lido Staked ETH registration.
  • The S-1 was filed for the first time on October 16, 2025 but not made effective.
  • No ETF shares were issued or sold and VanEck did not provide reasons for dropping the stETH cryptocurrency.

VanEck has officially put on the brakes on a long-anticipated U.S. exchange-traded fund (ETF) pegged to Lido staked Ether, concluding months of speculation in the cryptocurrency sector.

The asset manager filed a withdrawal request with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on October 14, 2026, confirming that it no longer intends to distribute shares of the proposed fund.

  • VanEck Withdraws Lido Staked Ethereum ETF Filing
  • No Shares Were Ever Issued
    • stETH ETF Plan Ends Without Replacement
    • Withdrawal Narrows VanEck’s Ethereum ETF Push

VanEck Withdraws Lido Staked Ethereum ETF Filing

VanEck Digital Assets filed a Form RW with the SEC that sought to withdraw the registration statement for the VanEck Lido Staked Ethereum ETF. The original Form S-1 was filed on October 16, 2025 under registration file number 333-290918 and was later amended.

VanEck indicated in a new filing that it withdrew its plans because the sponsor plans to not enter into the distribution of units of the trust.

The company didn’t specify what prompted the decision, which could have been due to regulatory concerns, market conditions, product strategy or something else.

Read More: Ethereum Hegotá Upgrade Puts 2 EIPs at Center of 62-Proposal Crypto Shakeup

No Shares Were Ever Issued

VanEck confirmed that it did not make the registration statement effective. It also stated that there was no distribution of any securities or a preliminary prospectus for the registration statement. That implies that the withdrawal ends the filing process prior to such product coming to the investors.

The new ETF was intended to sit at a stake position which is Lido’s own liquid staker protocol’s version of Ether, stETH, providing a secondary exposure to deposited ETH.

As a result of stETH being staked ETH and showing the accumulated staking rewards, the product offered was not exactly a traditional spot Ether ETF holding a position in ETH.

stETH ETF Plan Ends Without Replacement

VanEck didn’t state a successor fund or disclose if it plans to develop another Ethereum product focused on staking. The filing only states that the sponsor no longer plans to move forward with the existing trust. That leaves the prospects of VanEck’s Ethereum bet hanging in the balance.

Staking-based crypto ETFs have achieved attention due to their potential price exposure along with staking returns, whilst including more complexities upon the custody, rewards, liquidity and regulatory treatment.

Withdrawal Narrows VanEck’s Ethereum ETF Push

Another theme in the cancelled filing is the difference between traditional spot Ethereum exposure and investments over liquid staking tokens.

A stETH-based vehicle would have added another layer between investors and ETH itself, as stETH would be a claim relative to our staked ETH through Lido. But for now, VanEck has cut the route off.

The investors will not be able to access the planned Lido Staked Ethereum ETF via the structure originally proposed in the October 2025 edition.

title: Ripple Lands 4th Korea Deal, Bringing Custody and Tokenization to Meritz Securities
summary:
Key Takeaways: Ripple also signed an agreement with Meritz Securities, making it its 4th institutional deal in Korea this year. The companies will examine the infrastructure of Ripple Custody, along
The post Ripple Lands 4th Korea Deal, Bringing Custody and Tokenization to Meritz Securities appeared...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Ripple also signed an agreement with Meritz Securities, making it its 4th institutional deal in Korea this year.
  • The companies will examine the infrastructure of Ripple Custody, along with tokenization for the capital markets in Korea.
  • With over 85 licenses in more than 60 markets, Ripple now has 12 Korean banking, insurance and securities licenses that it serves.

Ripple is also beefing up its institutional footprint in South Korea with a fresh collaboration with Meritz Securities, a major South Korea security company. It is Ripple’s first capital markets deal with a Korean securities company.

  • Ripple and Meritz Target Tokenized Capital Markets
  • Meritz Explores ETFs, Security Tokens and KRW Stablecoins
    • Ripple Expands Across Korea’s Financial Sector
    • XRP Role Remains Undisclosed

Ripple and Meritz Target Tokenized Capital Markets

As part of the partnership, Meritz Securities has proposed the trial of the deployment of Ripple Custody and Ripple’s tokenization platform in its current securities business. Ripple Custody is intended for regulated financial institutions which require safer and more reliable infrastructure to secure them and move them.

Instead, Meritz would not have to develop the institutional stack from scratch, and could instead utilize the current institutional stack in order to serve Korea’s regulations.

The two companies are due to start in the scope of Meritz’s business to expand the partnership gradually in line with the progress of the digital asset framework in the country.

Read More: Ripple and Privy Bring XRP Wallets to XRPL After $1T Moved Across 8M Accounts

Meritz Explores ETFs, Security Tokens and KRW Stablecoins

Meritz is already looking at several digital asset business plans, such as spot ETFs, fractional investment, security tokens, digital asset trading platforms and stablecoins denominated in the Korean won.

This is a bigger picture plan, and the Ripple partnership is part of that. It, however, doesn’t indicate a production date or tokenized asset, nor does it confirm that any of those will roll out immediately on the Ripple infrastructure.

Ripple Expands Across Korea’s Financial Sector

Ripple’s partnership with Meritz is the fourth institutional one in Korea this year. Kyobo Life Insurance is collaborating with Ripple Custody on a project related to tokenization of Korean government bond settlement.

To utilize digital asset wallet infrastructure, Kbank is taking advantage of Ripple Custody’s service, while Jeonbuk Bank is utilizing Ripple Payments for cross-border remittances. This results in Ripple connections throughout three key sectors of Korea’s financial sector: banking, insurance and capital markets.

It has over 85 regulatory licenses and registrations in more than 60 markets around the world, said Ripple.

Read More: Ripple Taps DriveWealth to Bring RLUSD Settlement to 100+ Global Investing Partners

XRP Role Remains Undisclosed

The partnership will further enhance Ripple’s enterprise footprint, though Meritz does not announce that it will be issuing tokens directly on the XRP Ledger or that it will utilize XRP. Ripple Custody is able to power digital asset institutional operations without reliance on XRP.

Once a tokenized security or a stablecoin is issued on XRPL using XRP, XRP can be utilised for fees and account reserve payments on XRPL, however, it has not been confirmed.

As of yet, the agreement focuses on the custody and tokenization infrastructure, while the specific products and the blockchain architecture will rely on regulatory developments and Meritz’s ultimate decisions on which products to implement.

title: Coinbase’s x402 Records 138.5M Transactions: Chainalysis Shows AI Agents Reshaping Crypto Payments
summary: Coinbase’s x402 payment protocol recorded approximately 138.5 million transactions on the Base blockchain by the end of the third quarter of 2026, highlighting the rapid growth of cryptocurrency payments made by AI agents.
content:
Skip to content

Coinbase’s x402 payment protocol recorded approximately 138.5 million transactions on the Base blockchain by the end of the third quarter of 2026, highlighting the rapid growth of cryptocurrency payments made by AI agents.

According to blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis, activity has expanded sharply since the protocol’s early stages, as autonomous AI agents increasingly use digital assets to pay for online services.

The findings, published in Chainalysis’ October 14 report, North America: Inside the Growth of Agentic Commerce, point to an emerging use case for stablecoins and blockchain infrastructure. Rather than relying exclusively on conventional payment systems, AI agents can use crypto to settle small charges for data, application programming interfaces (APIs), and other digital services.

The US is leading the AI on-chain economy

The United States is emerging as a key center for the development of on-chain payments involving autonomous AI agents. Chainalysis identified Coinbase, which developed x402, and Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, as important companies supporting this activity.

Chainalysis data shows explosive growth in Base’s x402 activity, with cumulative distinct transactions by AI agents rising from 58,800 in Q3 2025 to 138.5 million in Q3 2026. Source: Chainalysis via X

The report recorded a sharp increase in x402 transactions on Base, an Ethereum layer-2 network associated with Coinbase. Cumulative activity rose from approximately 58,800 transactions in the third quarter of 2025 to 138.5 million by the third quarter of 2026. The figures indicate that the payment protocol has moved well beyond its initial scale, although transaction counts alone do not establish how much economic value the activity represents.

The underlying model, known as agentic commerce, allows AI agents to initiate and execute payments for specific tasks without requiring a person to authorize every individual transaction. For example, an agent retrieving information from a paid API could send a small payment for each request rather than depend on a conventional subscription or manually approved purchase.

Stablecoins are central to this approach because they can transfer dollar-denominated value over blockchain networks at relatively low cost. USDC is one of the digital currencies used in this developing payment ecosystem. Coinbase’s x402 infrastructure provides a mechanism for connecting payment requests with blockchain-based settlement, allowing software to pay for services programmatically.

The trend also has the attention of established financial institutions. Will Su, BlackRock’s head of digital assets research, told Chainalysis that the firm was watching agentic commerce closely, noting that AI agents could create “meaningful demand for frequent, low-value payments around the clock.”

AI agents drove XRP Ledger transaction growth, with daily settlements exceeding 600,000 in late September and early October 2026, peaking near 700,000, according to t54.ai data. Source: @BSCNews via X

The broader North American crypto market remains substantial despite a slowdown during the reporting period. Chainalysis estimated that the combined crypto economies of the United States and Canada reached $3.02 trillion in the 12 months ending July 1, 2026, down 1.9% from the preceding period. The US accounted for $2.78 trillion, a 2.2% decline, while Canada’s crypto economy grew 2.3%.

Hoolie Tejwani, head of Coinbase Ventures, attributed part of the industry’s development to a shift from infrastructure building toward practical applications. “A lot of what we’re seeing vs. 2025 comes down to maturation of the industry,” Tejwani said. He added that earlier investments were becoming “products with real users, liquidity, and markets in 2026.”

AI payments are becoming stickier

Chainalysis also found signs that x402 users are returning to the system after their initial funds run out, suggesting that activity is becoming more sustained. Among wallets that made payments on at least two separate days, the share receiving a second funding within 30 days increased from 70.6% for wallets first funded in the third quarter of 2025 to 89.3% for those first funded in the second quarter of 2026.

The figures suggest that more participants are replenishing their balances to continue using the payment system instead of treating it as a one-time experiment. However, wallet refilling is an indicator of continued use, not direct proof of commercial profitability or widespread adoption among businesses.

Coinbase’s x402 enables AI agents to make low-cost crypto payments, with 87% of transactions below $0.10 by September 2026, supported by low-fee stablecoin settlements. Source: Chainalysis via X

Another measure points to more deliberate participation. In late 2025, the median wallet waited 73 days between its initial funding and its first x402 payment. By the third quarter of 2026, that interval had fallen to just 18 minutes, according to Chainalysis. The shorter gap suggests that newer wallets are increasingly being funded specifically to make payments through the protocol.

The size of those AI agents’ payments helps explain the potential appeal of blockchain-based settlement. Chainalysis reported that more than 87% of x402 payments during its extended review period, which ended in September 2026, were worth between one-hundredth of a cent and 10 cents. The most common payment range was between one and 10 cents.

AI agents are increasingly making small, frequent payments for services such as code reviews, financial intelligence, data access, and API calls, supporting the growth of agentic commerce. Source: @chainalysis via X

Such transactions are difficult to support economically through conventional card networks, where processing costs can make very small purchases impractical. Blockchain transfers using stablecoins can settle for fractions of a cent under suitable network conditions, making pay-per-request services more feasible. Actual costs vary according to network fees and transaction conditions.

Circle described the distinction between payment methods as “card rails for consumer-prompted agent payments and stablecoin rails for machine-to-machine settlements that are too small for card economics.”

That division suggests that AI agents’ payments may complement existing financial infrastructure rather than immediately replace it. Card networks can continue to handle purchases initiated by consumers, while stablecoin payments may serve automated transactions between software systems.

For now, Chainalysis characterizes agentic commerce as an emerging market still in an experimentation phase. The rise in transactions driven by AI agents, increased wallet replenishment, and shorter time to first payment provide evidence of growing engagement with x402. Whether that activity develops into a durable commercial market will depend on practical demand, payment reliability, security, regulatory clarity, and the ability of businesses to turn automated transactions into sustainable services.

title: Aptos Encrypted Mempool Goes Live, Shielding Trades From MEV Bots With 20ms Delay
summary:
Key Takeaways: Aptos started hiding details of pending transactions in its Encrypted Mempool on mainnet. Validators are not the first to process transactions, thereby mitigating the possibility of frontrunning and
The post Aptos Encrypted Mempool Goes Live, Shielding Trades From MEV Bots With 20ms D...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Aptos started hiding details of pending transactions in its Encrypted Mempool on mainnet.
  • Validators are not the first to process transactions, thereby mitigating the possibility of frontrunning and sandwich attacks.
  • The system brings in around 20 milliseconds of the delay per block for 50 nodes.

Aptos has activated a protocol-native encrypted mempool on mainnet, giving users an optional way to hide transaction details until block ordering is finalized. The feature aims at mitigating a longstanding issue in DeFi: frontrunning and sandwich attacks on visibly pending transactions via MEV tactics.

  • Aptos Encrypts Transactions Before They Enter the Mempool
  • No Single Validator Can Unlock a Pending Transaction
    • Encrypted Mempool Targets Frontrunning and Sandwich Bots
    • Aptos Adds Privacy With About 20ms of Extra Latency

Aptos Encrypts Transactions Before They Enter the Mempool

If the feature is enabled by the users, its transaction payload is encrypted on the client before being sent to the network. Sensitive information like function call and arguments are hidden, but the sender address and gas fee are still visible.

Validators then confirm the ordering of the transactions without having to view the payment message itself. Validators then collectively decrypt the transactions if consensus has agreed on the block, allowing them to execute the transactions and add them to the blockchain record.

Read More: Sui’s Hashi Launches With $500M to Turn Bitcoin Into Productive DeFi Collateral Markets

No Single Validator Can Unlock a Pending Transaction

Aptos implements threshold encryption directly based on its current set of validators. No single validator is able to decode a pending transaction nor is any of the group below its required stake threshold.

We do not create any additional decryption committee or any private block builder or trusted hardware provider in Aptos. Rather than that, AQUA token conversion is handled by the same validators that facilitate the Aptos consensus.

Encrypted Mempool Targets Frontrunning and Sandwich Bots

The public mempools show transaction data prior to execution. That’s where automated trading bots find some opportunity to spot huge transactions, copy or execute trades before and after another trader.

With the payload secret and confirmed repayment order solved, Aptos eliminates numerous of the information these bots need to disrupt holding trades.

Protection may be particularly relevant for institutional orders, big DeFi trades and automated agents, as early disclosure of transaction intention may result in execution risk.

Petra is first to make the feature available as part of its signing process, letting users choose to encrypt a transaction at sign time. Additionally, a perpetual futures exchange on Aptos, Decibel, will be using encrypted mempool infrastructure to ensure that orders remain off-chain until they are executed.

Read More: Robinhood Launches AI-Native Chain, Stock Tokens in 120+ Countries and 7% Crypto Yield

Aptos Adds Privacy With About 20ms of Extra Latency

Running threshold encryption at blockchain scale adds to the computation required, but according to Aptos, the performance effect is minimal.

Its batched encryption design will allow it to decrypt an entire block with constant-size communication per validator, regardless of the number of transactions in the batch.

Testing with 50 nodes resulted in an additional 20 milliseconds per block over the production version of AptosBFT. The delay is insignificant as Aptos blocks are finalized in less than a second.

Restrictions in both of the first implementations prevent complete transaction anonymity. Sender addresses and gas information are still visible, while the transaction payload itself remains encrypted until block finalization.

Existing Move smart contracts do not require changes, and support is available through the Aptos TypeScript SDK version 7.0.0 and later.

title: Strategy Buys 250 Bitcoin for $21.5M, Sending Total Holdings to a Record 848,250 BTC
summary:
Key Takeaways: On its part, Strategy is said to have bought 250 BTC at $21.5 million or an average price of $86,194 per BTC. It owns a total of 848,250
The post Strategy Buys 250 Bitcoin for $21.5M, Sending Total Holdings to a Record 848,250 BTC appeared first on CryptoNinjas.
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • On its part, Strategy is said to have bought 250 BTC at $21.5 million or an average price of $86,194 per BTC.
  • It owns a total of 848,250 BTC, purchased at a total value of approximately $64.0 billion.
  • The company also used $192.4 million to buy back preferred STRC stock in the week.

Despite the purchase quantity decreasing, Strategy had added 250 Bitcoin to its holding between October 5 and October 11. Even as the buying volume subsided, Strategy had increased its Bitcoin holdings by 250 BTC between October 5 and 11.

The purchase brought the company’s total BTC holdings to 848,250 BTC, solidifying its position as the biggest corporate Bitcoin owners.

  • Strategy Adds 250 BTC for $21.5 Million
  • Bitcoin Treasury Reaches 848,250 BTC
    • Strategy Spends $192.4M Repurchasing STRC Shares
    • $4.88B Reserve Supports Strategy’s Bitcoin Capital Framework

Strategy Adds 250 BTC for $21.5 Million

In total, Strategy paid $21.5 million to buy the latest batch of Bitcoins including fees and expenses. The average price of acquiring one of these 250 BTC was $86,194 per Bitcoin for the company.

Income from two sources. Net proceeds from the sales of MSTR common stock funded an equal amount of the purchase; MSTR’s cash balance funded the remainder which amounted to approximately USD 500,000.

A total of 125,183 MSTR shares were sold this past week, yielding net proceeds of $21.0 million.

Bitcoin Treasury Reaches 848,250 BTC

As of 11 October, Strategy had 848,250 BTC in its balance. The total money allotted to the purchase of those assets at various times was around $64.0 billion, including fees and expenses, the company said.

That means Strategy has ended up paying an average of $75,444 per BTC for all of its Bitcoin holdings. The firm is sticking to its core capital approach, which involves equity issuance and cash reserves, and not on just one fund source, and continues to focus on the Bitcoin aspect of the business.

Strategy Spends $192.4M Repurchasing STRC Shares

Bitcoin was not the only big investment that Strategy made in the week. The Company purchased 1,932,145 STRC preferred shares for an aggregate purchase price of $192.4 million. STRF, STRK, STRD and MSTR have not had any repurchases reported for the same time period.

Strategy has $354.8 million under its optional preferred-stock repurchase program and $1.0 billion under its authorization to buy back MSTR common stock.

$4.88B Reserve Supports Strategy’s Bitcoin Capital Framework

As of October 11, Strategy also had $4.88 billion USD of Reserve and $640.5 million USD of separate USD Cash. The USD Reserve is the reserved share of the debt to support preferred-stock dividends and interest payments on the debt.

USD Cash can have a more salient role and may be used for the acquisition of Bitcoin, expansion of the reserves, or in other aspects of capital management. The firm has utilised $500,000 in those cash reservoirs for its latest Bitcoin investment, while the majority of the acquiring investment was made with new MSTR stock dollars.

title: Standard Chartered Brings RLUSD Custody to XRPL in 3-Way Institutional Custody Program
summary:
Key Takeaways: RLUSD’s listing on the XRP Ledger is now covered under Standard Chartered’s institutional custody program. The bank is negotiating with Ripple and LMAX group to qualify RLUSD as
The post Standard Chartered Brings RLUSD Custody to XRPL in 3-Way Institutional Custody Program appeared fi...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • RLUSD’s listing on the XRP Ledger is now covered under Standard Chartered’s institutional custody program.
  • The bank is negotiating with Ripple and LMAX group to qualify RLUSD as collateral for the bank.
  • The planned setup potentially will allow institutions to trade via RLUSD without transferring tokens to the venue.

Standard Chartered has taken another step into stablecoin infrastructure by launching custody support for Ripple USD, or RLUSD, on the XRP Ledger.

Now it is offered to eligible institutional traders from the bank’s Dubai International Financial Centre branch, and a wider collateral integration with Ripple and LMAX Group is underway.

  • Standard Chartered Launches RLUSD Custody on XRPL
  • RLUSD Could Stay in Custody While Supporting Trading
    • Ripple and LMAX Target More Efficient Stablecoin Collateral
    • Full Collateral Integration Is Not Live Yet

Standard Chartered Launches RLUSD Custody on XRPL

Standard Chartered’s digital asset custody infrastructure has now made eligible clients able to hold RLUSD. The service is offered through the bank’s DIFC branch, which is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority.

That provides another way for institutions to gain access to RLUSD, aside from crypto-native custodians. The move is targeted at those looking to gain access to digital asset markets without compromising on the importance of maintaining institutional level practices for long-term custody, governance and risk management, Standard Chartered Inc said.

RLUSD runs on the XRP Ledger, the platform that aims to deliver quick and cheap settlement for DeFi applications.

Read More: OKX Secures Circle, Ripple and Standard Chartered Backing at $25B Valuation

RLUSD Could Stay in Custody While Supporting Trading

The more noteworthy facet of the partnership is the envisioned cross collateral model. Standard Chartered and the LMAX Group plan to enable RLUSD to qualify for specific products and trading services.

According to this design, the client will not be required to transmit their RLUSD to the trading platform. LMAX, on the other hand, would be reimbursed by the bank Standard Chartered for the value of the eligible collateral, with the underlying tokens still held by the bank.

The model should help to mitigate operational risks associated with frequent transfers of assets and increase control around exposure to counterparties for institutions.

Ripple and LMAX Target More Efficient Stablecoin Collateral

Collateral mobility may be as critical to an institution as to the custody. Once the planned integration goes live, companies may potentially be able to keep RLUSD and apply its value throughout the LMAX trading infrastructure.

That could help to better utilize capital by eliminating the need for entities to shift capital from platform to platform. The true use cases for the ripple are where institutions want stablecoins to operate within a known and regulated financial environment, said Ripple.

Read More: Ripple Eyes Türkiye’s $200B Crypto Market as RLUSD and Bank Custody Gain Ground

Full Collateral Integration Is Not Live Yet

Custody service is already in place; however, the RLUSD collateral functionality is still in development at LMAX.

Final documentation, successful testing, regulatory requirements, internal approvals and jurisdictional readiness remain as factors that must be considered before the companies start implementing.

The partnership brings together three separate pieces of infrastructure: Ripple’s stablecoin and XRPL settlement layer, Standard Chartered’s institutional custody platform and LMAX Group’s trading marketplace.

Completed, it would transition the stablecoin to more direct involvement of RLUSD in institutional trading and collateral management, instead of the stablecoin being limited to payments and settlement.

The first product of the collaboration is slated for the market in Q1 of 2027.

With assets of $911.6 billion as of June 30, 2026, Federated Hermes will supply expertise in investment management and tokenized products.

Prometheum will provide regulatory infrastructure to distribute and service them. The structure is designed to take the same kinds of fund/broker relationships that many U.S. investors have for traditional funds and apply them to blockchain-based funds.

Read More: SEC Clears Path for Tokenized Stocks With 5-Year Onchain Trading Exemption

Broker-Dealers Can Access Tokenized Products Without Building Crypto Infrastructure

Issuing and distributing will be undertaken by Prometheum’s ProFinancial subsidiary while handling the custody, clearing and settlement will be undertaken by Prometheum Capital.

Without a need for a digital-asset custody and settlement system, such broker-dealers could then offer tokenized products to clients through a clearinghouse facilitated by Prometheum Capital.

That should help remove one of the largest hurdles to tokenizing assets: distribution.

There are numerous tokenized funds on blockchain networks, though many of these were only available through specialist platforms and not the usual brokerage accounts.

$14B Tokenized Fund Market Gets Traditional Distribution Route

There is already over $14 billion of tokenized U.S. Treasury and money market funds onchain, says Prometheum. The partnership is designed to give that growing asset class a more direct path into regulated brokerage infrastructure.

Blockchain-based access to traditional investments products is attracting demand from broker-dealers and registered investment advisers, said Federated Hermes.

Instead of replacing established financial intermediaries, the model keeps broker-dealers, custodians and clearing firms at the center of the transaction flow.

Read More: OKX Eyes 63 U.S. Stocks in Major Tokenized Trading Expansion

Prometheum Builds Full Stack for Tokenized Securities

Prometheum’s larger overall structure features multiple regulated entities with various stages of the securities lifecycle.

ProFinancial is responsible for issuance and distribution, Prometheum Capital is a custody and clearing service and Prometheum ATS has registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as a digital transfer agent.

That entity provides the company with a playbook to follow for tokenized securities from issuance to custody to eventual trade. At Federated Hermes we are able to add to that the scale that we have, we are over 11,000 institutions and intermediaries globally.

If the launch of Q1 2027 is as expected, the partnership could prove the capability of tokenized funds to successfully get onto investor investable networks beyond cryptocurrency exchange platforms.

title: Coinbase Joins 4-Day Crackdown on West Africa Crypto Scams and Asset Freezes
summary:
Key Takeaways: Coinbase participated in a four-day assault of scam networks in West Africa in London. Its Global Intelligence team tracked illicit crypto activity, aided asset freeze operations, and provided
The post Coinbase Joins 4-Day Crackdown on West Africa Crypto Scams and Asset Freezes appear...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Coinbase participated in a four-day assault of scam networks in West Africa in London.
  • Its Global Intelligence team tracked illicit crypto activity, aided asset freeze operations, and provided intelligence sharing with law enforcement.
  • The impersonation scams included fake crypto investments and staged video-call arrests by the police.

Coinbase has joined a coordinated enforcement effort aimed at disrupting scam networks expanding into West Africa.

During an operation in London, Oct. 6 – 9, the exchange collaborated with the UK’s National Crime Agency, the U.S. Department of Justice’s Scam Center Strike Force, Tech Against Scams and other international partners.

  • Coinbase Traces Crypto Flows Behind Scam Networks
  • Scammers Used Fake Investments and Staged Arrests
    • West Africa Emerges as a New Focus
    • Coinbase Keeps Pressure on Crypto Fraud Networks

Coinbase Traces Crypto Flows Behind Scam Networks

Coinbase’s Global Intelligence team was dedicated to tracking illegal funds related to scam operations. The company said investigators helped trace funds, supported asset freezes and could help ongoing criminal investigations for the company.

The work integrated blockchain transaction data with other elements of the digital ecosystem, such as fake social media profiles, messaging accounts, and fraudulent sites.

That can aid investigators connect activity that might appear disjoint when it shows on various platforms. The purpose was not just to shut off individual accounts, Coinbase said, but also to uncover the underlying systems that are being leveraged to mask the movement of stolen assets and run scams.

Read More: Coinbase Unveils AiFi After $100M in x402 Transactions, Targeting AI Agent Payments

Scammers Used Fake Investments and Staged Arrests

The operation was directed at various aspects of fraud. Coinbase identified fake cryptocurrency investment schemes, a virtual arrest via video call designed to flex the power cords, and criminals posing as law enforcement officers.

Often scams are executed over numerous services until any funds end up in a crypto wallet or exchange. The victim might first be contacted via social media, then switched to a private messaging service after which they are asked to pay using financial channels.

That’s why enterprise-level intelligence sharing is particularly valuable when the investigators are trying to uncover the entire scheme.

West Africa Emerges as a New Focus

Effort to crack down on scam compounds across Southeast Asia has compelled certain criminal organisations to expand their activities to other global areas such as West Africa, Coinbase said.

Every effort has been made to disrupt networks that could have built stronger infrastructure in London. Members focused on the accounts, communications and payment mechanisms that facilitate scam activity.

The work also signals another trend for tech vendors, financial institutions, telecom and security organizations all getting more involved with investigations, coordinated efforts.

Coinbase Keeps Pressure on Crypto Fraud Networks

Coinbase has previously tracked down scams in a similar fashion. The company has explained that its part in the latest campaign was ensuring that blockchain intelligence could be merged with data collected by third party organizations and would enable police to respond quicker.

Vice President Leah Bressack described the strategy as sustained pressure on criminal networks that move between regions and platforms.

Coinbase said it plans to continue working with Tech Against Scams and law enforcement partners to trace illicit funds, disrupt active schemes and support investigations against the groups operating them.

title: Ethereum (ETH) Price Prediction: ETH Holds Near $2,500 as ETF Flows Turn Positive and Long Positions Reach Four-Year High
summary: Ethereum holds near $2,500 as ETF flows turn positive and longs hit a four-year high, with traders watching $2,600 for a breakout toward $3,000.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: ETH

Ethereum holds near $2,500 as ETF flows turn positive and longs hit a four-year high, with traders watching $2,600 for a breakout toward $3,000.

Ethereum is holding close to $2,500 after a volatile start to October, with the market now showing a mixture of improving institutional flows and elevated derivatives positioning. According to Brave New Coin, ETH is trading around $2,511.53, up 0.08% over the past 24 hours, after spending much of the session between roughly $2,490 and $2,530.

Ethereum Fractal Pointing Toward $4,600

Ethereum’s latest structure is beginning to resemble the setup that preceded last year’s larger advance. In 2025, ETH spent several weeks consolidating around the mid-$2,000 region before a sharp downside sweep briefly pushed price below support. That move was quickly reversed, and the reclaim eventually developed into a much stronger trend.

Famous crypto analyst Ash Crypto is highlighting a similar sequence in the current market. ETH has returned toward the $2,400-$2,300 region after the latest decline, placing the focus on whether buyers can recover and maintain this zone. If price stabilizes here, the recent selloff could begin to look more like a liquidity sweep than a sustained breakdown.

Ethereum’s current structure resembles the consolidation and downside sweep that preceded the larger 2025 expansion. Source: Ash Crypto via X.

The earlier cycle also shows that the recovery did not move straight toward the highs. ETH price first pushed through $3,000, then spent time consolidating in the mid, $3,000s before extending toward roughly $4,800. A similar progression in 2026 would bring the $4,600-$4,800 region back into focus, but only if the current support structure holds.

For now, the comparison remains conditional, not predictive. A sustained recovery above $2,400-$2,500 would strengthen the fractal and shift attention toward $3,000 as the next major step, while another breakdown below the recent low would weaken the setup and suggest that Ethereum still needs to establish a firmer base first.

Bitfinex Longs Reach Four-Year High

Ethereum Bitfinex bulls are ramping up their positioning for a potential major breakout. Data shared by Crypto Rover shows ETH long positions surging to their highest level in four years, with exposure rising sharply while price remains around the $2,500 region.

The buildup points to strong bullish conviction beneath the current market structure. Rather than waiting for Ethereum price to confirm a breakout first, smart money appears to be building long exposure during the consolidation, suggesting expectations of a much larger move once price begins clearing resistance.

The scale of the increase is also important. Long positioning has accelerated well beyond the levels seen during previous periods, showing that traders are committing more aggressively to the upside scenario. If ETH continues holding the $2,400-$2,500 base, this positioning could add further momentum to the next breakout attempt.

Ethereum long positions have reached their highest level in four years while price continues to trade near the $2,500 region. Source: Crypto Rover via X

Ethereum Sees $24.84M in ETF Inflows

Institutional flows have finally shown some improvement after a difficult stretch for Ethereum ETFs. U.S. spot ETH products recorded approximately $24.84 million in net inflows on October 13, marking the first positive session after 10 consecutive trading days of outflows.

Ethereum ETFs returned to net inflows with approximately $24.84 million on October 13 after 10 consecutive sessions of withdrawals. Source: Trader T via X

Trader T’s data shows Grayscale’s mini Ethereum ETF accounting for approximately $16.73 million of the daily inflow, while Fidelity’s FETH added another $8.11 million. The shift is notable after the previous session recorded roughly $85.43 million in net outflows and the five-day total had fallen to around $576.9 million in withdrawals.

If ETH ETF demand continues to recover while ETH holds above $2,500, institutional flows could begin providing a more supportive backdrop for the next rebound attempt.

Contrary: Whale Positioning Remains Cautious Below $2,600

Not all positioning data supports the bullish side yet. Ethereum’s Whale vs Retail Delta remains below zero, indicating that larger traders continue to carry greater short exposure than retail participants.

The imbalance has nevertheless improved. Data shared by CW8900 shows the delta recovering from much more negative levels recorded through September, while whale short positioning has also declined. That suggests larger traders are reducing some defensive exposure even though they have not yet shifted decisively bullish.

This distinction helps explain why ETH price remains stuck around $2,500 despite improving ETF flows and aggressive long positioning elsewhere in the market. A further recovery in the whale-retail delta, particularly alongside a move through $2,550-$2,600, would provide stronger evidence that larger participants are becoming more comfortable with the rebound.

Ethereum’s whale-versus-retail delta remains negative, although the gap has narrowed as whale short exposure declines. Source: CW8900 via X.

Ethereum Price Prediction: $2,600 Reclaim Could Reopen $3,000

Ethereum’s near-term price prediction is becoming easier to define after the latest volatility. The $2,400-$2,500 region has developed into the main base, while $2,600 remains the level buyers need to recover before the rebound can expand into a broader trend move.

A reclaim of $2,600 would improve the technical picture considerably and bring $2,700 back into focus. From there, the larger $3,000 level becomes more relevant, particularly if the historical fractal continues to hold and spot demand improves alongside the move.

The downside case is more straightforward. If ETH loses $2,400 and fails to recover the level quickly, the current base would begin to weaken, and the market could be forced into a deeper reset before another larger recovery develops.

What Traders Should Watch Next

The real question now is whether improving positioning can finally translate into Ethereum price strength. ETH longs are at a four-year high, ETF flows have returned to positive territory, and whale short exposure has started to ease, creating a noticeably stronger backdrop than earlier in the correction.

Ethereum price is trading at around $2,511, up 0.08% in the last 24 hours. Source: Brave New Coin

What traders need next is follow-through. A breakout supported by stronger spot demand and continued institutional inflows would carry more weight than another short-lived bounce, while renewed ETF selling or a return of aggressive whale shorts would weaken the recovery narrative. The next few sessions should therefore show whether the improvement beneath the surface is beginning to reach the chart.

title: Gold Price Analysis: XAU/USD Eyes Recovery Toward $4,200 Resistance
summary: Gold has come back from the 2026 highs to about $4,156 per ounce, where a vital support zone is now coming into view.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: XAU

Gold has come back from the 2026 highs to about $4,156 per ounce, where a vital support zone is now coming into view.

One analyst considers the break below $4,140 as a nullification of the bullish setup but believes that $4,150-$4,160 is a potential area of interest for buyers. The weekly chart also indicates that money flow has turned negative, and traders will be interested to see if a buying defense can be sustained or if selling pressure will continue the pullback.

Gold Price Tests Support Between $4,150 and $4,160

After retesting its 2026 highs, gold is coming into a sweet spot, as traders monitor if buyers will go on the defensive at $4,150. An analyst on X noted that the 4150-4160 level could be a good top entry point for a bull run, while the area below $4140 would be a negative sign.

The analyst’s posting on October 13th does not spell a definite reversal but a trading plan, contingent upon a few conditions. Traders may consider going long if gold is trading above the recognized support level. But a drop below $4,140 would be a red flag to put the “buy” mentality on hold.

A possible recovery towards resistance at $4,200 is indicated on the accompanying chart. It also shows a slight dip followed by a bounce up, indicating that the analyst believes gold will retest support levels and then bounce back upward. Source: Cali Via X

The forecast is based on the price action in the vicinity of the entry area. If the price of gold stays above $4,150, the proposed scenario would be supported, but continued selling could bring the precious metal down.

The analyst also mentions some potential profit targets in the accompanying post, which are 100, 300, and 500 points. These are not targets but possibilities, and the situation relies on support to hold up.

Gold Price Chart Shows Pullback From 2026 High

A technical chart from TradingView displays Gold Spot’s weekly time frame against the U.S. dollar (XAU/USD). The displayed price is $4,156.005, down $38.640, or 0.92%, in the October 13, 2026 chart.

The longer-term chart indicates that gold has been moving higher since 2024 and 2025 and then sparked a rapid uptrend in 2026. The metal rallied to a new high before prices started to head back from the top. Source: TradingView

Gold has ceased its recent trend of rising, but it is still above its previous historical trading range. The chart depicts that the price broke out from a steep move and is now coming back, not continuing to follow an upward trend.

The new reading positions gold in the $4150–$4160 range that is highlighted in the X analysis. This overlap makes the zone worth considering, but the weekly TradingView chart does not necessarily validate the shorter time frame entry point indicated in the analyst’s post.

The two charts are also on different time frames.

The X post is about a short-term trading space, and TradingView displays the price history for gold over a longer time frame. Therefore, the suggested correction to $4200 must be considered a short-term scenario and not as a viable trend reversal.

Gold Price Momentum Declines as Money Flow Becomes Negative

The Chaikin Money Flow indicator (CMF) is part of the TradingView chart and is used to evaluate buying and selling pressure based on price and volume. It shows a reading of -0.02, which is only below the neutral level of zero.

When the CMF indicator has a negative reading, money is flowing out of the market instead of into the market during the period of time that the indicator measures. But it is near zero and not strong enough to confirm bearish selling pressure.

There is also an indication of increased trading during portions of the massive surge and subsequent pullback in gold. The recent pullback follows a significant range of activity, and traders will be eager to see whether the market holds up, so volatility could increase ahead.

The short-term forecast is for the $4150–$4160 range, as this is the next zone to monitor. Buyers have to defend it, and gold may try to reverse back to the $4,200 resistance level, which is shown in the X chart. A trend-confirming move in that area would give some more validation of a turnaround, though the chart doesn’t suggest that this will happen.

The negative side of the picture is that a decline below $4,140 will jeopardize the bullish outlook of the analyst. Traders would then have to evaluate if gold will find a bottom at the current price.

As a whole, the X time frame is in a buying situation, and the weekly chart of gold is correcting from a strong bull market run. The price of $4,140 in XAU/USD could be a key level to see if the current pullback reaches a bottom or continues.

Apia, Samoa, October 14, 2026 – The crypto market saw a notable rally in the just-concluded third quarter. It was also the quarter in which HTX turned 13. Over the past 13 years, the industry has weathered multiple bull and bear cycles, and HTX has stood alongside users worldwide throughout them. Resilience in navigating market cycles has been a defining characteristic of HTX over the past 13 years.

To mark its anniversary themed “Resilience Reveals the Future”, HTX launched the 13th-Anniversary Carnival and Trading Championship #3, among other celebratory events, in the third quarter, celebrating alongside users worldwide. Meanwhile, the platform continued to invest in TradFi, trending assets, yield products, and global compliance, delivering an outstanding quarterly performance report.

13th-Anniversary Celebrations Conclude, with Participation from Users Worldwide

On August 13, HTX kicked off its 13th-anniversary celebrations with the Anniversary Carnival. Its spot, futures, Earn and lending businesses rolled out exclusive anniversary promotions in succession, launching a celebration that lasted more than a month.

The annual trading competition Trading Championship #3 was the centerpiece of the anniversary celebrations. It attracted 45,000 registrations and generated 6.8 billion USDT in futures trading volume, making it the platform’s largest campaign of the quarter by both participation and trading volume. Meanwhile, HTX futures copy trading volume grew 21% quarter over quarter.

For spot trading, a series of 13th-anniversary campaigns, including the Individual Challenge, Trending Cryptos Margin Trading Carnival, and Points Tasks, played a key role in driving spot trading growth during the quarter. Over the three-month period, HTX launched 14 themed spot trading campaigns, attracting more than 46,000 registrations and generating over 500 million USDT in trading volume across the campaigns.

For 13 years, HTX and users worldwide have navigated one market cycle after another together. The anniversary celebrations were both a gesture of appreciation for users’ long-term support and a reflection of HTX’s determination to carry its resilience into the next 13 years.

TradFi Asset Offerings Expand as Quarterly Trading Volume More Than Doubles

In the third quarter, HTX listed 183 new futures assets, including 154 stocks and index-related assets. As of now, the platform offers 278 tradable stock assets, spanning US stocks, major global indices and ETFs, pre-IPO unicorns, and leading companies in Japan and South Korea, continuing to lead the industry in multi-market stock asset coverage.

HTX’s asset lineup focuses on four key sectors: AI hardware and semiconductor computing power, global e-commerce and internet companies, leading Asia-Pacific companies and major indices, and high-dividend blue-chip stocks. AI and semiconductor computing, leading Asia-Pacific companies, and pre-IPO unicorns were key themes throughout the quarter. Popular assets such as POLYMARKET, OURA and MOONSHOT were also listed. Eligible users can access global market opportunities through HTX without switching between platforms. This service is not available in jurisdictions subject to regulatory restrictions.

The expanded asset lineup drove rapid growth in trading volume. So far the cumulative TradFi trading volume on HTX has approached $6 billion, with $4.1 billion generated in the third quarter alone, more than doubling the cumulative total from the previous quarter.

The trading experience was upgraded alongside these developments. Stock perpetual futures feature a dividend settlement mechanism, allowing position values to adjust more continuously when an underlying stock goes ex-dividend and reducing the impact of non-trading-related price adjustments on users’ positions. TradFi asset detail pages include market data, news updates, and company profile, bringing key information together in one place. Dedicated categories for stocks, commodities and ETFs have also been added to market rankings, making it easier for users to discover assets. HTX has also upgraded its TradFi trading fee structure, bringing its net trading fees into the industry’s top tier.

HTX is also taking a longer-term view of the convergence of traditional finance and crypto markets. As real-world assets (RWAs), particularly tokenized stocks, become an increasingly important area of development in the global digital asset industry, the platform is monitoring regulatory developments and exploring regulatory frameworks and compliance pathways in preparation for future product innovation. All related products and services offered by the platform operate within the framework of applicable laws and regulations, and access restrictions are applied to users in certain jurisdictions as required.

Trending Assets Emerge as Earn and Lending Products Put Funds to Work Efficiently

In the third quarter, HTX listed new projects attracting strong market interest, several of which were first listed on the platform. Niulai was the quarter’s top-performing newly listed token, recording a peak gain of more than 500%. DOS and STONK each recorded peak gains of 240% after listing.

Earn and lending products expanded alongside new asset listings. During the quarter, HTX Earn changed the launch schedule for its new-token products from weekly updates to real-time synchronization with new listings, allowing users to access corresponding Earn products as soon as eligible popular tokens become available. Nearly 500,000 users participated in HTX Earn during the quarter, with subscription amounts totaling nearly 1 billion USDT. SVIP Flexible Earn products added BTC and ETH, expanding the options available to users with large holdings. In addition, SmartEarn introduced a trading-linked APY boost, offering a base APY of 4% upon activation and up to 9% APY for users who meet the required trading volume threshold. This further expands the yield potential for idle assets.

Margin and Convert features added 21 tradable assets, with XAUT becoming the first precious metal asset available through Convert. This further expanded the range of assets available for trading, borrowing and use as collateral. Loan interest rates are adjusted frequently in response to market conditions across more than 50 cryptocurrencies. Interest rates for large loans remain among the lower levels in the industry.

Risk management tools were also upgraded. Trailing stop orders and MMR TP/SL orders were launched successively. Stop-loss levels can automatically track market movements, giving users with large positions and high leverage greater flexibility in managing risk.

Advancing Global Compliance and Making a Major Brand Appearance at TOKEN2049

Compliance is a prerequisite for global expansion. In the third quarter, HTX made further progress on compliance initiatives in several key markets. In Dubai, the establishment of the relevant applicant entity received preliminary approval from the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), with subsequent regulatory applications and compliance reviews proceeding as planned. In Pakistan, following the formal publication of virtual asset service regulations and the launch of a licensing application process, HTX continued to advance the establishment of its local entity, its formal license application, and the development of its compliance framework, building on the No Objection Certificate (NoC) already obtained from the Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (PVARA).

HTX continued to strengthen its presence in regional markets. In August, HTX Ventures participated in Conviction Vietnam, building connections with local users and Web3 ecosystem partners. As the fourth quarter began, HTX appeared at TOKEN2049, a major annual gathering for the global crypto industry. Held in Singapore from October 7–8, the event brought together projects, investment firms, developers, and industry builders from around the world. HTX Ventures exhibited at the Sands Expo and Convention Centre in Singapore, engaging invited guests through brand displays and on-site interactions. Justin Sun, adviser to HTX and a core supporter of HTX DAO, attended related events and delivered a speech. He visited the HTX Ventures booth to meet with the team and other industry participants.

At Future Night, a private, invitation-only event hosted by HTX DAO during the same period, Justin Sun shared his views on industry trends via video. He noted that the crypto industry is becoming more closely connected with traditional finance. AI is changing how wealth is created, while crypto and digital finance are transforming how wealth is held and transferred. He also said that stablecoins could play a greater role in global payments and settlement, while the on-chain adoption of traditional assets such as bonds, funds and gold is likely to continue developing. The free flow of value in the digital world, he said, will be an important trend to watch over the next decade.

During the event, HTX DAO also hosted a private VIP dinner. Justin Sun met face to face with industry representatives, ecosystem contributors, and partners to exchange views on industry developments, market changes, product experiences, and future collaboration.

HTX DAO Ecosystem Expands as Q3 $HTX Burn Approaches

HTX DAO continued to support the long-term value of $HTX in the third quarter by steadily implementing its deflationary mechanism through quarterly token burns, while expanding $HTX use cases and building consensus among developers and the community. These efforts aim to lay a solid foundation for the ecosystem’s long-term development.

On July 15, HTX DAO completed its Q2 2026 $HTX token burn, valued at more than $13.6 million, bringing cumulative burns and donations to 117.79 trillion tokens. In line with its quarterly burn schedule, the Q3 $HTX token burn is scheduled to take place on October 15.

On the ecosystem front, HTX DAO focused on developers and the community. The Genesis Hackathon, co-hosted by HTX DAO and B.AI, attracted more than 200 developer teams exploring $HTX use cases, AI agent finance, on-chain asset management, and DAO tools. At Future Night, HTX DAO ambassador Molly shared that several projects developed by global university teams participating in the hackathon had advanced to further incubation stages and were exploring ways to integrate with use cases across the $HTX ecosystem.

Molly also shared that nearly 200 active volunteers were independently contributing to HTX DAO community development. In the fourth quarter, HTX DAO plans to develop regional community nodes to support members in organizing events and exchanging ideas.  She also noted that HTX, as an ecosystem participant, continues to optimize withdrawal fees, gather user feedback, and improve the app experience.

Navigating Market Cycles with Resilience, Shaping the Future Together with Users Worldwide

Thirteen years ago, HTX began as a digital asset trading platform. Today, it has grown into a comprehensive blockchain ecosystem serving users worldwide. Over the years, markets have experienced both highs and lows, and the industry landscape has evolved. Throughout these changes, HTX has remained committed to putting users first. Regardless of market conditions, improving its products and prioritizing the security of user assets remain among the platform’s top priorities.

Standing at the beginning of its 14th year, HTX will continue to navigate market cycles with resilience and build the future together with users worldwide.

About HTX

Founded in 2013, HTX has evolved from a virtual asset exchange into a comprehensive ecosystem of blockchain businesses that span digital asset trading, derivatives, research, investments, incubation, and other businesses.

Guided by its vision to “Achieve Financial Freedom for 8 Billion People Worldwide,” HTX works to make the digital asset space more accessible to a broader audience. The platform continues to develop its products and services in response to user needs and an evolving industry landscape.

title: Bitcoin (BTC) Price Prediction: Slowing Whale Selling Offers Hope as $81.5K ETF Support Holds
summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is consolidating near $83,000–$84,000 as repeated resistance at $84,000 limits recovery, while the $81,500 US spot Bitcoin ETF cost basis remains a critical support level.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: BTC

Bitcoin (BTC) is consolidating near $83,000–$84,000 as repeated resistance at $84,000 limits recovery, while the $81,500 US spot Bitcoin ETF cost basis remains a critical support level.

On-chain data indicates that distribution from longer-term holders has slowed, offering some relief to the market. However, weakening bullish momentum and persistent overhead resistance leave the next Bitcoin price move dependent on whether buyers can defend key support and reclaim higher levels.

Bitcoin Price Today: BTC Struggles to Break Above $84K

Bitcoin continues to trade within an $82,500–$86,500 range, but recent price action suggests that buyers are struggling to regain control. According to a technical analysis published by TradingView contributor inchartswetrust, BTC has faced rejection at $84,000 seven times since Sunday, preventing a sustained move toward the upper boundary.

Bitcoin recorded a second false breakdown below $82,500 in 24 hours, with the 4-hour 200 EMA providing strong support and triggering another rebound. Source: inchartswetrust on TradingView

The repeated rejections are significant because $84,000 represents the midpoint of the current trading range. Although the price has recovered after briefly falling below $82,500, those rebounds have failed to generate lasting upward momentum. Similar attempts on October 8 and October 13 lost strength near the same resistance level.

The analyst also identified the four-hour 200-period exponential moving average (EMA) as an important source of support. The indicator has helped reverse two previous breakdown attempts, suggesting that buyers remain active during short-term declines. However, repeated tests of support can leave the market vulnerable if demand weakens.

For the near-term BTC price outlook, reclaiming $84,000 would provide an initial indication that buying pressure is improving. Until that happens, Bitcoin remains exposed to another test of the lower end of its trading range.

Bitcoin ETF Cost Basis at $81.5K Remains a Key Support

On-chain analytics firm Glassnode has identified the US spot Bitcoin ETF investor cost basis near $81,500 as an important market threshold. BTC has rebounded from this level twice in 2026, making it a closely watched reference point for assessing demand from ETF investors.

Bitcoin has rebounded twice from the US spot ETF cost basis near $81,500, establishing support after trading below that level for most of 2026. Source: @glassnode via X

The level also carries historical significance. During the May 2026 rally, Bitcoin’s advance stalled just below the ETF cost basis, highlighting its potential role as both support and resistance depending on market conditions. Its recent ability to hold as support offers some reassurance, although it does not guarantee that buyers will defend it during another decline.

If BTC falls below $81,500 and fails to recover, Glassnode’s True Market Mean near $77,500 becomes the next major on-chain level to watch. This metric provides another reference point for evaluating Bitcoin’s market valuation relative to the aggregate cost basis of active investors.

The chart shows longer-term buyer cost bases still acting as overhead supply, limiting BTC upside while price consolidates above key on-chain averages. Source: Glassnode via X

Meanwhile, Glassnode’s data indicates that a previous rally toward $88,000 encountered resistance near the break-even level for holders who acquired BTC six to 12 months earlier. The subsequent distribution from wallets holding coins for one to two years has slowed considerably.

The easing of this selling pressure could reduce one source of supply in the market. Nevertheless, longer-term holders’ cost bases remain potential overhead resistance, meaning Bitcoin may need stronger demand to sustain a recovery.

BTC Price Prediction: Can Bitcoin Reclaim $88K?

Technical analyst AliCharts has identified an ascending parallel channel on BTC’s four-hour chart. Under this structure, the recent rebound from the lower boundary creates a potential path toward $88,000 near the channel’s midpoint, followed by $93,000 if upward momentum continues toward the upper boundary.

Bitcoin has bounced from its 4-hour ascending channel support, targeting $88,000 mid-channel and potentially $93,000 at the upper boundary. Source: Ali Martinez via X

These levels represent technical scenarios rather than confirmed price targets. BTC would first need to establish stronger support and overcome the repeated resistance around $84,000 before a sustained advance becomes more convincing.

The immediate bullish scenario depends on BTC holding $82,500. If buyers defend this level and push the price above $84,000, Bitcoin could move toward the upper end of its current $82,500–$86,500 range. A breakout above $86,500 would strengthen the recovery structure and bring higher resistance levels into focus.

The bearish scenario begins with a decisive break below $82,500. In that case, $80,000 would become the next major level to monitor. This price area previously acted as resistance, making it a potentially important test for buyers attempting to prevent a deeper correction.

A sustained move below $80,000 could expose the $76,000–$80,000 trading range. Bitcoin’s ability to establish or recover support around these levels would help determine whether the decline represents a temporary setback or a broader deterioration in market structure.

Looking Ahead: Whale Selling and Market Supply Remain in Focus

Slowing distribution from older Bitcoin holdings provides a constructive development, but it should not be interpreted as definitive evidence that large holders have resumed accumulating BTC. A reduction in selling activity can ease supply pressure without necessarily generating enough demand to drive prices higher.

Bitcoin (BTC) price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

The ETF cost basis also offers a useful measure of investor positioning. When BTC trades above this level, ETF investors who acquired exposure near the average cost may remain in a more favorable position. A sustained decline below it could weaken sentiment and increase attention on lower support levels.

Bitcoin’s longer-term recovery will depend on several factors, including spot demand, ETF-related flows, the behavior of long-term holders, and its ability to overcome established resistance. The supplied market data identifies $81,500 as a key support reference, while $84,000 remains the immediate hurdle for a stronger short-term recovery.

For now, the Bitcoin price prediction remains conditional. Holding $82,500 and reclaiming $84,000 would improve the technical outlook, while a breakdown could bring $80,000 and potentially $77,500 into focus. Slower whale selling offers some relief, but buyers still need to demonstrate that demand can sustain a move beyond the current range.
